title: Smoked Salmon and New Potato Salad
blurb: Tender new potatoes with smoked salmon, peppery rocket and a light yoghurt dressing.
steps: Cut the new potatoes in half and place them in a pan of cold salted water. Bring to the boil and cook for 15 to 18 minutes until tender when pierced with a knife.
While the potatoes cook, finely chop the chives and mix them into the yoghurt with the juice of half the lemon and a grinding of black pepper.
Drain the potatoes and let them cool for a few minutes, then cut any larger pieces into bite-sized chunks.
Tear the smoked salmon into rough pieces with your fingers.
Arrange the rocket on two plates and top with the warm potatoes and torn salmon.
Spoon the yoghurt dressing over each portion and finish with a drizzle of olive oil and a wedge of the remaining lemon.
